targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  h.host_name,
  h.first_seen,
  h.last_seen,
  CASE
    WHEN h.last_seen < UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) - INTERVAL 10 DAY THEN
      '{"background-color":"rgba(245, 54, 54, 0.9)","color":"white"}'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS last_seen_style,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tr.status = 'pass' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pass_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tr.status = 'fail' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS fail_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tr.status = 'skipped' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS skipped_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tr.status = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS error_count,
  COALESCE(COUNT(tr.id), 0) AS total_tests
FROM hosts h
LEFT JOIN test_results tr ON tr.host_id = h.id
LEFT JOIN test_runs r ON r.run_id = tr.run_id
WHERE r.started_at BETWEEN
  CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__from}/1000), @@session.time_zone, '+00:00')
  AND CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__to}/1000), @@session.time_zone, '+00:00')
  AND (
    '${cluster:csv}' = ''
    OR '${cluster:csv}' = '__all'
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM test_result_markers trm
      WHERE trm.test_result_id = tr.id
        AND trm.marker_name = 'cluster'
        AND trm.marker_value = '${cluster:csv}'
    )
  )
GROUP BY h.id, h.host_name, h.first_seen, h.last_seen
ORDER BY h.host_name;

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  h.host_name,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tr.status = 'pass' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pass_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tr.status = 'fail' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS fail_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tr.status = 'skipped' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS skipped_count
FROM hosts h
LEFT JOIN test_results tr ON tr.host_id = h.id
LEFT JOIN test_runs r ON r.run_id = tr.run_id
WHERE r.started_at BETWEEN
  CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__from}/1000), @@session.time_zone, '+00:00')
  AND CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__to}/1000), @@session.time_zone, '+00:00')
  AND ('${bar_hosts:csv}' = '__all' OR FIND_IN_SET(h.host_name, '${bar_hosts:csv}') > 0)
  AND (
    '${cluster:csv}' = ''
    OR '${cluster:csv}' = '__all'
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM test_result_markers trm
      WHERE trm.test_result_id = tr.id
        AND trm.marker_name = 'cluster'
        AND trm.marker_value = '${cluster:csv}'
    )
  )
GROUP BY h.id, h.host_name
ORDER BY h.host_name;

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT trm.marker_value AS __value, trm.marker_value AS __text FROM test_result_markers trm JOIN test_results tr ON tr.id = trm.test_result_id JOIN test_runs r ON r.run_id = tr.run_id WHERE trm.marker_name = 'cluster' AND trm.marker_value IS NOT NULL AND trm.marker_value <> '' AND r.started_at BETWEEN CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__from}/1000), @@session.time_zone, '+00:00') AND CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__to}/1000), @@session.time_zone, '+00:00') ORDER BY trm.marker_value
